_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the registry 'placeholder token' grammar. A value is a placeholder token iff it begins (after optional leading whitespace) with a TODO / TBD / XXX word-token, regardless of the punctuation that follows. This table is asserted by BOTH the C# gate (VerifyRegistryCommand.LooksLikePlaceholder) and the Python gate (verify_crossfile_consistency.is_placeholder_token) via cross-language tests, so the two implementations can never silently drift again. The historical bug this guards: the extractor's default 'TODO — ...' (em-dash) passed C# but failed Python. NOTE: empty string is NOT a token here (placeholder=false) — callers treat empty separately per field.
